snip.cap: Poinsett to Monroe, 14 June 1814: the clerk’s words over the code groups
snip.credit: National Archives (USA), RG 59, M37 roll 2 frame 0098, via catalog.archives.gov

system: Numbered two-part code of about 1,600 groups: common words as single groups, longer words spelled from syllable groups; a circle over a group adds -s.
